translation_notes: graph.subjects(predicate=rdf:type, object=self.eliozoNS.Problem) becomes m{ ?subj rdf:type {self.eliozoNS.Problem} }(graph) -- trav_one_step in reverse (subject unbound), directly expressible the same way.

the four graph.value(subj, self.eliozoNS.X) reads become m{ {subj} {self.eliozoNS.X} ?v }(graph).first(), one island per property -- not joined, since the original reads each independently (each wrapped in its own try/except with its own `continue`), and a join would change which properties get read once problemGrade or problemYear is missing.

the region's own return value is a fixed status tuple, so the oracle in driver.py compares the properties dict recorded through a fake Weaviate client's insert() call (context_shim.py's _Self.__eq__) rather than the return value or a graph -- otherwise this would be a hollow green.
context_shim.py's eliozoNS IRI (http://www.dudajevagatve.lv/eliozo#) is the real one from the pinned commit.
